posts.title: Which bio?
posts.description: Which bio? Occasionally, I'll get a ping on Matrix from someone asking for the source on my bio (or some other comment on it). The issue is, each time I have to ask them, "which bio did you see?". This often confuses people - what do you mean "which one"? Well, about that... I have over 25, and growing. And in this post, I'm going to explain how! Because it was kinda fun.
